Meanwhile, Coremerch offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure, designed for creators in restricted countries, with a focus on ownership, automation, and delivery, without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle operate in a limited number of countries, leaving creators in 149 countries without access to their services. Teachable relies on Stripe for payment processing, which means that if Stripe is not available in your country, Teachable won't work either. Coremerch, on the other hand, is designed to work around these restrictions, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that can be deployed in any country, without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle charge transaction fees, ranging from 2.9% + 30¢ to 3.5% + 30¢, while Teachable charges a flat rate of 2.9% + 30¢. Coremerch offers a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with no additional fees for delivery or automation. When it comes to payment speed, Coremerch's NOWPayments integration ensures instant payment verification, while Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle can take up to 2-3 business days to process payments.
Don't rely on Stripe or PayPal for payment processing.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle require you to give up ownership of your customer relationships and data, while Teachable locks you into their ecosystem, relying on Stripe for payment processing. Coremerch, on the other hand, provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to own and control your business, with automated delivery and payment verification, without relying on Stripe or PayPal.

If you're willing to pay a bit more, Teachable offers a more comprehensive platform, but still relies on Stripe for payment processing. If you want to own and control your business, with automated delivery and payment verification, and can handle the technical setup, Coremerch's Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go.
